title: HM Land Registry OKF first-release candidate questions
description: A bounded set of 24 candidate competency and retrieval questions. Expected propositions are hypotheses for independent verification, not gold answers.
suite_boundary: The suite samples critical first-release roles and risks. It does not claim complete coverage of HM Land Registry services, users, law, guidance, datasets or APIs.

direct_source_baseline.method: For each question, open the named canonical official source, record the page or contract identity and observation date, then compare the expected propositions and limitations with the bundle result.
comparison_dimensions: release, observation, registration and catalogue dates
restrictions: Do not create an account or make a paid transaction.
Do not call authenticated APIs, the portal, Business Gateway or restricted search services.
Do not store credentials, certificates, session state or signed download links.
Treat expected propositions as candidates until independently reviewed.

hard_failures.description: A general or indicative boundary, title-plan line or INSPIRE polygon is presented as the exact legal boundary or definitive registered extent.
The result states or implies open, free or reusable access where an account, fee, bespoke licence, third-party right or other restriction applies.
A GOV.UK or catalogue modification date, bundle generation date or observation date is presented as dataset release, registration or legal currency.
An unofficial, derived, normalized or catalogue assertion is presented as an official HMLR statement, or an informational online copy is presented as official proof.
The bundle performs, recommends or appears to authorize automated access to an authenticated, paid, portal, Business Gateway or terms-restricted service, or exposes a credential.
The result claims complete geographic, authority, service or dataset coverage without a named denominator, as-of date and visible exclusions.
A critical discovery or evidence-inspection task cannot be completed using a keyboard or lacks an accessible name, visible focus, status announcement or non-visual equivalent.
Welsh availability or source-native Welsh content is suppressed, mistranslated, merged into English without a language distinction or falsely described as unavailable.

retrieval.description: Find the expected official source or evidence-bearing bundle record and preserve search/filter state.

display.description: Show the expected proposition, scope, access, date and legal or spatial limitation clearly.

accessibility.description: Support keyboard and assistive-technology inspection, focus, status and language requirements.

govuk.description: Resolve canonical provenance, distinguish authority and derivation, state licence/access correctly and avoid every hard failure.

questions.query: What does HM Land Registry cover?
questions.intent: Find the official statement of HMLR's remit and avoid applying the bundle outside its jurisdiction or authority.
expected_propositions: HMLR registers ownership of land and property in England and Wales.
The OKF bundle is a discovery aid and does not replace HMLR's authoritative records or services.
questions.near_miss_rule: A result about Scotland, Northern Ireland, the wider UK housing market or a secondary catalogue does not establish HMLR's remit.

questions.query: title register title summary title plan differences
questions.intent: Distinguish the main property-information products and what each contains.
expected_propositions: The title register, title summary and title plan expose different information.
A title plan normally shows general rather than exact boundaries.
questions.near_miss_rule: A result that treats the three products as interchangeable or describes the title plan as exact is not correct.

questions.query: online copy or official copy proof of ownership
questions.intent: Find the route and limitation that distinguishes informational downloads from official copies.
expected_propositions: An online copy is not proof of ownership.
Official copies have a distinct order route and evidential role.
questions.near_miss_rule: Merely linking to a paid download without explaining its evidential status is insufficient.

questions.query: does a title plan show the exact legal boundary
questions.intent: Retrieve authoritative boundary guidance and expose the general-boundaries limitation.
expected_propositions: Most registered title boundaries are general boundaries.
A determined boundary is a distinct recorded status and must not be inferred from map precision.
questions.near_miss_rule: A map scale, red edging or coordinate precision does not establish an exact legal boundary.

questions.query: practice guide general agreed determined boundaries
questions.intent: Find the current official practice guidance needed to distinguish boundary concepts.
expected_propositions: HMLR practice-guide supplements distinguish general boundaries from agreements and determined boundaries.
The current official guide identity and update context remain inspectable.
questions.near_miss_rule: A blog post, forum answer or old PDF without a current canonical guide route is not sufficient authority.

questions.query: address search misses title search of the index map
questions.intent: Find the official recovery route when a property address search may not reveal every affected title.
expected_propositions: Searching only by property details may not show every title affecting the property.
A search of the index map is the documented alternative for the relevant task.
questions.near_miss_rule: Retrying broader address text is not equivalent to the documented index-map process.

questions.query: portal Business Gateway professional access requirements
questions.intent: Distinguish professional service guidance from public discovery and make access restrictions visible.
expected_propositions: Portal and Business Gateway are professional service surfaces with approval or credential requirements.
Public documentation does not authorize the bundle to make a transaction or production call.
questions.near_miss_rule: A public developer page is not evidence that the production service is anonymous or open for unrestricted automation.

questions.query: what mortgage or lender information is in title information
questions.intent: Find what title information says about a lender or discharged mortgage without overstating evidential completeness.
expected_propositions: Title information may identify a lender or indicate whether a mortgage has been discharged.
The required official evidence route remains distinct from the bundle summary.
questions.near_miss_rule: Absence of a field in a summary is not proof that no charge or relevant entry exists.

questions.query: Price Paid Data current property value limitations
questions.intent: Retrieve the official Price Paid Data description, temporal coverage and reuse limitations.
expected_propositions: Price Paid Data records qualifying lodged transactions rather than a current valuation.
Its coverage, update and accuracy notes must remain visible.
questions.near_miss_rule: A historic transaction amount is not a current valuation or proof of the current registered proprietor.

questions.query: catalogue modified date versus dataset release date
questions.intent: Test whether the bundle keeps catalogue, observation, release and registration dates separate.
expected_propositions: Discovery-catalogue timestamps describe the catalogue record, not necessarily the underlying dataset.
Publisher-operated release information is the operational source for dataset cadence and current files.
questions.near_miss_rule: A recent page or bundle timestamp cannot repair an unknown dataset-release date.

questions.query: HM Land Registry spatial datasets GIS GML shapefile API
questions.intent: Discover the publisher catalogue and compare spatial products by format, access and GIS requirement.
expected_propositions: HMLR spatial products differ in format, cost, licence, update schedule and API availability.
Some polygon downloads require GIS software and can be large.
questions.near_miss_rule: A generic data catalogue record without the publisher's current access and technical details is insufficient.

questions.query: INSPIRE polygon indicative or legal boundary
questions.intent: Verify that spatial discovery polygons are not presented as exact legal title or charge boundaries.
expected_propositions: Local Land Charges INSPIRE data shows indicative locations.
Indicative geometry is a discovery aid and does not establish an exact legal title boundary.
questions.near_miss_rule: Displaying a polygon on a precise basemap does not upgrade its legal meaning.

questions.query: which local authorities are in Local Land Charges INSPIRE data
questions.intent: Find the dated authority-level coverage statement and known migration limitation.
expected_propositions: Not every local authority dataset has migrated to HMLR.
Coverage must be stated against the observed authority list and date.
questions.near_miss_rule: The phrase England and Wales does not prove complete authority coverage.

questions.query: spatial metadata CRS vintage Welsh place names
questions.intent: Test whether spatial records retain format, CRS or coordinate context, vintage, authority and language metadata where the source supplies them.
expected_propositions: Spatial metadata should preserve the source, release or vintage, format and coordinate-reference information where available.
Welsh place names require language-aware presentation rather than silent normalization.
questions.near_miss_rule: A place label or representative point must not be converted into invented source geometry.

questions.query: Use land and property data API base URL version datasets
questions.intent: Retrieve the publisher-operated API contract, version and supported dataset scope.
expected_propositions: The service documents a RESTful JSON API under a versioned base URL.
The publisher documentation, not a central catalogue row, defines the operational contract.
questions.near_miss_rule: An API catalogue entry without the publisher contract cannot establish current operations or authentication.

questions.query: what HMLR API data is public and what requires an account licence key
questions.intent: Distinguish public API documentation and example metadata from authenticated dataset access.
expected_propositions: Public documentation and some example data can be inspected without treating the underlying dataset as anonymous access.
Authenticated dataset access requires the documented account, licence acceptance and API key.
questions.near_miss_rule: A publicly visible API URL or example response does not authorize anonymous bulk download.

questions.query: which HM Land Registry services must not be automated anonymously
questions.intent: Ensure restricted portal, Business Gateway, local-search and authenticated data routes are discoverable without being invoked.
expected_propositions: Public guidance may be indexed while transactional, search or production service calls remain restricted.
The bundle must not make authenticated calls or preserve credentials and signed links.
questions.near_miss_rule: Robots accessibility or a public landing page is not equivalent to permission to automate a service.

questions.query: OCOD monthly complete file change only update
questions.intent: Find the distribution and refresh contract needed for a reproducible monthly update.
expected_propositions: OCOD publishes a complete monthly file and a change-only update.
A refresh must preserve file identity, release context and source observation rather than infer currency from the catalogue page.
questions.near_miss_rule: A page last-updated date is not a substitute for the file's release identity or covered month.

questions.query: search local land charges coverage account official certificate
questions.intent: Find how public and official local-land-charge searches differ and whether an authority is covered.
expected_propositions: The service covers England and Wales but authority migration remains relevant.
A user account and an official certificate route have distinct access and fee implications.
questions.near_miss_rule: A free personal search is not automatically an official search certificate.

questions.query: local land charge planning condition title boundary differences
questions.intent: Prevent conflation of local land charges, planning information, title registration and mapped boundaries.
expected_propositions: Local land charges can include restrictions such as planning conditions but are not the complete planning record.
The search service, charge record, title record and indicative spatial dataset are distinct entities.
questions.near_miss_rule: A matching polygon or planning-related label does not prove the legal scope of a charge or registered title.

questions.query: OCOD licence address data third party rights
questions.intent: Retrieve the dataset-specific licence and keep third-party address-data conditions visible.
expected_propositions: OCOD reuse is governed by a dataset-specific licence.
Property-address fields carry third-party intellectual-property conditions that must not be collapsed into a generic open-data statement.
questions.near_miss_rule: Public catalogue access or Crown ownership does not establish unrestricted redistribution of every field.

questions.query: Price Paid Data OGL attribution Royal Mail Ordnance Survey
questions.intent: Find the required attribution and layered address-data reuse conditions for Price Paid Data.
expected_propositions: Price Paid Data is published under OGL with a specified attribution.
Address fields include third-party rights and their reuse conditions must remain visible.
questions.near_miss_rule: Stating only OGL without the address-data conditions is incomplete.

questions.query: Use land and property data accessibility keyboard focus WCAG
questions.intent: Retrieve the applicable accessibility statement and test the bundle's equivalent critical journey.
expected_propositions: The publisher exposes an accessibility statement with keyboard, screen-reader, zoom and known-focus limitations.
The OKF site must test its own search, filter, result and source-link journey rather than inherit the source service's claim.
questions.near_miss_rule: A passing automated audit alone is not evidence that the complete keyboard and screen-reader task works.

questions.query: HM Land Registry Welsh language services bilingual registers
questions.intent: Find the official Welsh-language commitment and preserve bilingual service and register context.
expected_propositions: HMLR identifies public services, correspondence and register contexts available in Welsh or bilingually.
Welsh labels need explicit language metadata, including mitigation for known screen-reader pronunciation issues.
questions.near_miss_rule: An English-only result is incomplete when the official source declares a Welsh route or bilingual context.
